primary_prior_art.work: Time-uniform confidence bands for the CDF under nonstationarity

public_code.classification: time-uniform confidence backend and separation diagnostic; not an end-to-end action-complete full-consequence partition estimator

findings: optional-stopping-safe multinomial and distributional inference is existing prior art
time-uniform validity does not create samples for uncovered actions
pairwise merge/separate decisions need not be transitive and do not define a partition without a global rule
nonstationary running-average inference does not identify a stationary point-MDP target law
approximate B4 requires a preregistered global tolerance-indexed partition, simultaneous error allocation, action coverage or abstention, and a stationarity/context contract
counterexamples: two complete MDPs with identical observed action-a streams and different never-sampled action-b consequences remain observationally indistinguishable despite anytime-valid monitoring
pairwise approximate merge decisions can violate transitivity and conflict with a certified separation
two context-varying systems can share a running-average consequence law while differing in context-conditional controlled laws and target partitions
decision_text: Optional-stopping-safe confidence sequences and e-processes are existing prior art and can support early separation or tolerance-based abstention, but they do not create action coverage, do not alone enforce a globally consistent greatest partition, and do not turn a nonstationary average law into a stationary target ontology.
next_gate: amend LBQ001 with an explicit global approximate-mode estimand
freeze simultaneous error allocation across pairs actions channels and time
require generative coverage or permanent abstention
only then pin and execute a public confidence backend with seeds 17 29 43 and resource logs
